content: Hi how can i assist you today
Image CAPTCHAs keep asking me to click things related to what I’m thinking—like bikes when I was thinking of a bike ride.
Those prompts come from a fixed pool aimed at distinguishing bots, not thoughts. Were you on a site about travel or maps at the time?
Yes, I was looking at a map just before the CAPTCHA.
Maps and travel pages frequently trigger categories like traffic lights, buses, or crosswalks. If you save two or three examples, the categories often repeat across unrelated sites too.
I’ve clicked crosswalks and buses a lot.
That repetition is typical of the category pool rather than personalization.
